script:
$env:ProgramData = 'C:\ProgramData'
$env:TEMP = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Temp'
$env:TMP = $env:TEMP
$env:ANDROID_HOME = 'C:\Android\sdk'
$env:ANDROID_SDK_ROOT = $env:ANDROID_HOME
$env:NDK_HOME = 'C:\Android\sdk\ndk\30.0.15729638'
$env:JAVA_HOME = 'C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium\jdk-17.0.20.8-hotspot'
$env:Path = "C:\Program Files\nodejs;$env:USERPROFILE\.cargo\bin;$env:JAVA_HOME\bin;$env:ANDROID_HOME\platform-tools;$env:Path"
Write-Host '=== DB VERSION ==='
Get-Content src-tauri\resources\danbooru.version
$py = @'
import gzip, os, shutil, sqlite3, tempfile
src = r"src-tauri\resources\danbooru.sqlite.gz"
fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".sqlite")
os.close(fd)
try:
    with gzip.open(src, "rb") as fsrc, open(tmp, "wb") as fdst:
        shutil.copyfileobj(fsrc, fdst)
    db = sqlite3.connect(tmp)
    tables = [r[0] for r in db.execute("select name from sqlite_master where type='table'")]
    print("tables:", tables)
    assert "tags" in tables, "tags table missing"
    cols = [r[1] for r in db.execute("pragma table_info(tags)")]
    print("tag columns:", cols)
    name_col = "name" if "name" in cols else ("tag" if "tag" in cols else cols[0])
    sql = f"select * from tags where lower({name_col}) like ? or lower({name_col}) like ? limit 30"
    rows = db.execute(sql, ("%runami%", "%yachiyo%")).fetchall()
    print("runami/yachiyo matches:", rows)
    names = [str(r[cols.index(name_col)]).lower().replace("_", " ") for r in rows]
    assert any("runami" in n and "yachiyo" in n for n in names), "runami yachiyo is missing from latest Danbooru DB"
    print("RUNAMI_YACHIYO_OK")
finally:
    try: db.close()
    except Exception: pass
    if os.path.exists(tmp): os.remove(tmp)
'@
$pyPath = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'verify-danbooru.py'
$py | Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 $pyPath
python $pyPath
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
if (!(Test-Path node_modules)) { npm.cmd ci; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } }
Write-Host '=== FRONTEND BUILD ==='
npm.cmd run build
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
Write-Host '=== CARGO CHECK ==='
cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri\Cargo.toml
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
Write-Host '=== ANDROID APK ==='
npm.cmd run tauri -- android build --apk -t aarch64 --ci
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
$apk = 'src-tauri\gen\android\app\build\outputs\apk\universal\release\app-universal-release.apk'
if (!(Test-Path $apk)) { throw "APK not found: $apk" }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force .agent\out | Out-Null
Copy-Item $apk '.agent\out\NAI-V5-Studio-0.4.8-latest-translation-arm64.apk' -Force
Get-Item '.agent\out\NAI-V5-Studio-0.4.8-latest-translation-arm64.apk' | Format-List FullName,Length,LastWriteTime
Write-Host 'BUILD_COMPLETE'
